purpose: Domain-owned foundations and orientation for the full programme-to-domain-to-subgroup-to-role model.

rules.domain_foundation: domain definition + named domain evidence + strong CCMAS curriculum anchors; never role prevalence
rules.subgroup: inherits the domain foundation and adds subgroup-specific records, methods, tools and resources
rules.role: inherits domain/subgroup context and adds role work, skills, tools, credentials and role resources
rules.programme_relationship: direct, functional and adjacent edges retain their evidence and downstream route

domains.name: Software Engineering

orientation.whatItStudies: Software engineering is the discipline of designing, building and testing computer programs and mobile applications. Practitioners write and debug code, analyse what a program should do, test software at different levels, and manage changes to systems, in roles such as software analyst, tester, mobile application developer and cloud engineer. They typically work in technology firms, banks, telecoms companies and government agencies.
